verdict.rationale: Obsidian itself has no first-party AI feature in its docs; AI-generated insights are only possible via third-party community plugins like Text-Generator, and even community members note there is 'no decent RAG functionality among Obsidian AI plugins.' This shows the capability exists only as a bolted-on extension with acknowledged quality gaps, not a native product feature. Missing for 10: first-party AI insight/suggestion feature, native RAG over vault data, vendor documentation of AI capabilities, evidence of reliable AI-driven suggestions inside the core app.
